title: Hazel and the Harvest
author: Isandro Thackeray
blurb: Theo Whitlock, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
